shots.content: Inside a meeting room, a rectangular conference table stands between a presentation screen and a glass door, with windows along one side; a clear walkway runs opposite the window. A woman in a yellow shirt sits in the screen-side walkway seat and proposes taking a restorative countryside holiday trip. A man in a purple shirt sits in the door-side walkway seat. A man in a red shirt sits in the screen-side window seat. A woman in a green shirt sits in the door-side window seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the glass door end, looking along the conference table toward the presentation screen, with both window-side seats and both walkway-side seats and the presentation screen in frame.

shots.content: The man in the purple shirt rejects the countryside plan and suggests a sea voyage, while the woman in the yellow shirt asks about potential travel difficulties.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the window side, centered on the two adjacent walkway-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in the yellow shirt details the drawbacks of a sea voyage.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the window side, centered on the person at the screen-side walkway seat.

shots.content: The man in the red shirt proposes a river holiday instead, and the woman in the yellow shirt and the man in the purple shirt discuss whether to choose it.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot of the conference table.
